stories.title: Life-Saving Emergency Surgery
stories.heading: Emergency Surgery Saved My Father's Life
stories.subHeading: A family's gratitude after urgent general surgery at Hijaz Hospital's emergency department.

articleContent.text: When my father collapsed with acute abdominal pain, we rushed him to Hijaz Hospital's emergency department. Within hours, the surgical team diagnosed a life-threatening condition and performed emergency surgery.

The doctors explained every step to our family. Because we could not afford the full cost of treatment, the patient welfare team guided us through financial assistance. My father recovered and returned home — a outcome we had feared we would not see.
They treated my father as if he were their own family.

stories.title: Successful Orthopedic Surgery
stories.heading: Walking Again After Orthopedic Surgery
stories.subHeading: Recovery after complex orthopedic procedure and physiotherapy rehabilitation.

articleContent.text: After a serious leg injury, I was unable to walk without assistance. The orthopedic team at Hijaz Hospital performed surgery and coordinated physiotherapy rehabilitation over several months.
Today I walk independently and have returned to daily activities. The combined care from surgery and rehabilitation teams made recovery possible.

stories.title: Cardiac Care Recovery
stories.heading: Cardiac Team Saved My Mother's Life
stories.subHeading: Critical cardiac care and ICU support for a heart attack patient.

articleContent.text: My mother suffered a severe cardiac event and was admitted to Hijaz Hospital's ICU. The cardiology and anesthesia teams stabilized her condition and provided round-the-clock monitoring.
She spent weeks recovering under specialist care. We are deeply grateful for the nurses who never stopped encouraging us during the hardest days.

stories.title: Free Cataract Surgery
stories.heading: I Can See My Grandchildren Again
stories.subHeading: Welfare-funded cataract surgery restored vision for an elderly patient.

articleContent.text: Cataracts had left me nearly blind. Through Hijaz Hospital's welfare program, I received cataract surgery at no cost. The ophthalmology team treated me with kindness throughout.
The first time I saw my grandchildren's faces clearly again, I cried.

stories.title: Dialysis Welfare Support
stories.heading: Welfare Support for Dialysis Treatment
stories.subHeading: How zakat and donor support sustain long-term dialysis for deserving patients.

articleContent.text: When I was diagnosed with end-stage kidney disease, I could not afford regular dialysis. Hijaz Hospital's patient welfare team enrolled me in a support program covering treatment costs and ration assistance.
Three years later, I continue dialysis at the hospital with dignity. Donors who support Hijaz make this possible for patients like me.

stories.heading: Successful Urology Procedure
stories.subHeading: Minimally invasive urology surgery with rapid recovery.

articleContent.text: The urology team performed a minimally invasive procedure that resolved chronic symptoms I had endured for years. Recovery was faster than I expected, and follow-up care was thorough.

stories.title: Safe Delivery Story
stories.heading: A Safe Delivery at Hijaz Hospital
stories.subHeading: Comprehensive maternity care for a high-risk pregnancy.

articleContent.text: My pregnancy was classified as high-risk. The gynaecology team monitored me closely through OPD visits and admitted me when complications arose. Both mother and baby were safe after delivery.
The nursing staff on the maternity ward supported our family with warmth and professionalism throughout our stay.
